name: DeerFlow
description: Open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness by ByteDance: skills, memory, sandboxes, subagents, tools and a message gateway.
description_zh: 字节跳动开源的长时间跨度 SuperAgent harness：技能、记忆、沙箱、子代理、工具与消息网关。
_source_description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.

name: Cordis
description: Meta-Framework of Spatiotemporal Composability — the plugin runtime DeepSeek Harness is built on.
description_zh: 时空可组合性元框架——DeepSeek Harness 底层的插件运行时。

name: sandbase-harness
description: Open-source CMA-compatible agent runtime for any model: MCP tools, sandboxed sessions, audit, replay.
description_zh: 开源 CMA 兼容的任意模型 Agent 运行时：MCP 工具、沙箱会话、审计与回放。
_source_description: Open-source CMA-compatible agent runtime for any model, with MCP tools, sandboxed sessions, audit, replay, and a local console. Includes a native DeepSeek Harness bundle over stdio MCP.

name: mnemon
description: LLM-supervised persistent memory for AI agents: graph-based recall and cross-session knowledge in a single binary.
description_zh: LLM 监督的 Agent 持久记忆：图召回与跨会话知识，单二进制。
_source_description: LLM-supervised persistent memory for AI agents — graph-based recall, cross-session knowledge, single binary. Works with DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, OpenClaw, and any agent runtime.

name: claude-paper
description: Cross-agent research paper toolkit for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness: quick summaries and deep dives.
description_zh: 跨 Agent 论文研究工具包：快速摘要与深度精读，支持 Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode/DSH。
_source_description: 📖 Cross-agent research paper toolkit for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and DeepSeek Harness—quick summaries, deep study materials, code demos, and a local web viewer.

name: open-managed-agents
description: Open-source Claude Managed Agents API implementation and self-hosted Claude Tag-style agent runtime.
description_zh: 开源 Claude Managed Agents API 实现与自托管 Claude Tag 风格 Agent 运行时。
_source_description: Open-source Claude Managed Agents API implementation and self-hosted Claude Tag-style agent runtime. Drop-in compatible; runs on Cloudflare Workers/Durable Objects or Node.js. Apache 2.0.

name: Axern
description: Open-source sandboxes for AI agents: untrusted code execution and durable services.
description_zh: 面向 AI Agent 的开源沙箱：不可信代码执行与持久服务。
_source_description: Open-source sandboxes for AI agents, untrusted code execution, and durable services.

name: deepseek-auto-evolving-harness
description: Auto-evolving LLM agent harness: benchmark-driven evolution via Claude Code and a self_evolution.md guide.
description_zh: 自进化 LLM Agent Harness：通过 Claude Code 与 self_evolution.md 指南进行基准驱动进化。
_source_description: Auto-evolving LLM Agent Harness - Benchmark-driven evolution via Claude Code + self_evolution.md guide
